content: To be friends with many people in the way of perfect friendship is impossible, just as it is impossible to be in love with many people at once.
author: Aristotle
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. We spend enormous energy trying to present a sanitized, perfect version of ourselves to the world. But whatever emotions or desires we push into the dark don't disappear; they run our lives from behind the curtain.

In Aristotle's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. True maturity isn't pretending you have no dark corners—it is having the honesty and courage to look at your jealousy, fear, and anger in the daylight so they no longer control your actions.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
